hints.title: Single Inversion Point
hints.text: A sorted array rotated right by some steps has at most one index i where nums[i] > nums[i+1].

hints.title: Boundary Condition
hints.text: If exactly one drop occurs, the last element nums[-1] must also be strictly less than or equal to the first element nums[0].

hints.title: Shift Calculation
hints.text: If zero drops occur, the array is already sorted, returning 0. If one drop occurs at index i with valid boundaries, return n - 1 - i.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all n right shifts and checking sortedness takes O(n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify single descent point in rotated sorted array.
